source_unit.access: existing local bound media only; no external access or adjacent household page

specific_prior_readings: T-0149 own reference-field 93.3 with adjacent glyph comparisons
documentary_reuse.rule: Retain all exactly sufficient documented fields without automatic full reread; older text-copy disagreement alone is not reason to reopen whole post.

new_control_only.physical_extent: C-0002 own post 86 on already bound local image; inspect only as needed to determine its printed/written header and column map and own post boundaries
map: printed and written header/column labels and order
which cells belong to post 86 rather than adjacent rows
relevant blank cells and explicit unread or uncertain boundaries
targeted_independent_readings: entire baptism-witness column, retaining each uncertain name/place/role glyph and blank boundary
new_control_only.if_other_unmapped_cells_found: Record exact column and uncertainty for later bounded assessment; do not expand automatically to full image/page rereading, adjacent household folio or new generation.

FIRST.prior_material_visibility: Must not see older transcriptions, current documentary conclusions or SECOND reading before locking output; only scoped image/locator and neutral field grid instructions.
FIRST.output: full independent raw map and targeted readings with positions and uncertainty, hash-locked before comparison

SECOND.prior_material_visibility: Knows older documentary text, but must not see FIRST output before locking own reading; label PRIOR_AWARE_INDEPENDENT_CONTROL, not blind to old data.
SECOND.output: own raw map and targeted readings with positions and uncertainty, independently hash-locked before comparison

reader_protocol.comparison_gate: Compare only after both FIRST and SECOND outputs are saved and SHA-locked; preserve disagreements and decide any further narrow read explicitly.

copy_impact.rule: No dependent operation/apply until root adjudication and source-control comparison; later proposal versions are not approved by this plan.

person_adoption.scope: exact bounded adoption step during later source audit for this record and direct copy impacts
person_adoption.not_implied: No automatic whole-person or PK-level approval.

exclusions: No new household page or adjacent image opening.
No repeat of completed T-0675/T-0676 passages.
No native apply or Wotan completion.
